notes: 0.3.40：待确认路径也算告警。0.3.39 只把「根外绝对路径」和「被覆盖的配置」算告警，待确认路径退成卡内中性提示；现在三类都算：status 的 localPaths.alert = 待确认 + 根外 + 被覆盖，按钮按它变橙并显示「本机路径 · N 项告警」，卡内待确认块与它的「待确认 N 项」徽标也恢复成橙色。
notesEn: 0.3.40: paths still to confirm count as warnings again. 0.3.39 treated only "absolute paths outside every root" and "overwritten configs" as warnings and demoted the pending ones to a neutral notice; now all three count - status.localPaths.alert = pending + outside-root + overwritten, the button turns amber reading "Local paths - N alert(s)", and the pending block plus its chip are amber again.
